scope: W6.2 producer/lookup quality + W6.2.BIND reviewedSet/final claims notice; branch vorflux/w6-review-quality; OpenCode Space Bunny; no UI/UX change
commitNote: các dòng probe chạy trên cây làm việc dựa trên baseCommit; cây đó được commit thành commit (dòng probe vẫn ghi commit gốc tại thời điểm chạy)

deliverable.lookup: Answer <=120 words + Sources opened + Unverified; no options or recommendation
deliverable.researchBrief: research node with depth=brief: Answer, Verified facts, Gaps, <=400 words, no options section
deliverable.proportionalNote: plan/design deliverables append a proportional note (findings <=8, claim <=300 chars)

deliverable.unsourcedClaim: answer_knowledge(): a claim naming a path/URL that was not opened marks the binding verification='unverified' and error='WORK_CLAIM_UNSOURCED: <path>'
deliverable.reviewedSet: finish_verify() on verdict ok writes run['reviewedSet'] = {wholeBinding, artifacts[], claims[], reviewedAt, verdict}; result() returns stale=true when the whole binding or a reviewed artifact hash changed
deliverable.finalClaims: runtime.final_claim_notices() at main turn end emits work_notice {type:'unreviewed_claims'} (non-blocking) for tokens outside reviewedSet.claims that carry no 'chưa kiểm/unverified' label
deliverable.mainLanguage: SOP section G requires the owner-facing commentary in the owner language (Vietnamese with accents)

nativeProbe.design: A/B on the same fixture: legacy arm = node without taskKind (pre-W6.2 behaviour), lookup arm = taskKind=lookup; 1 run each
nativeProbe.oracleNote: strict raw count: the Answer part (everything before the sources heading) must be <=120 words; the lookup arm measured 122 raw / 119 without headings, so the strict oracle fails by 2 words while the shape (sections, length class) matches the contract.

legacy: Rủi ro và điều chưa rõ

mechanism.oracle: lookup arm: Answer <=120 words, a sources-opened section, no options/recommendation section
mechanism.result: legacy 1050 words / no sources section vs lookup 254 words total (122 raw in the Answer part, 119 without headings) with Nguồn đã mở + Chưa kiểm and no options section; the strict 120-word count fails by 2 words, the section shape and the length class match the contract
